_comment: Public FUT presentation assets served by the local FUT listener: the bundled copy wins, then the per-user cache, then EA's CDN (validated, then cached). Request paths are lower-cased; remotePath keeps the CDN's case.
_itemBackgroundPathComment: Card backgrounds FIFA downloads for rarities whose art the game does not carry (Sudamericana, Libertadores, Player Moments, Season Reward, Icon Swaps 4 were seen live): itemBGs/<the rarity's guid in futitemraritytunables.json>/cards_bg_<size s|c|e|j>_1_<rarity>_<n>.dds. Served like a player head: bundled copy, cache, then the CDN (a DDS no larger than maxAssetBytes); a miss is a 404 (Python server _cached_item_background).
_downloadTimeoutComment: How long one CDN download may take. A download that runs longer is abandoned and not cached; the next request tries again.
